Probably from using too short of primers that were only 6 nucleotide in length.</p><p>Choose the correct pair of RNA primers that will amplify the remaining region of DNA inside the old primers using <strong>nested PCR</strong>. and 5&prime;-TGGTAG-3&prime;.</p><p>But the first PCR run contained significant contamination due to mispriming.
